3. Update devbob-secrets: kubectl create secret generic devbob-secrets -n metabob --from-literal=github-token=ghp_xxx --from-literal=git-user-name='Devbob Agent' --from-literal=git-user-email=devbob@metabob.local --from-literal=anthropic-api-key=$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
4. Apply StatefulSet changes (if not using Helm): kubectl apply -f k8s-devbob-statefulset.yaml
5. Rollout restart: kubectl rollout restart statefulset/devbob -n metabob
6. Wait for rollout: kubectl rollout status statefulset/devbob -n metabob
